assessment: Paid scenic cable car from Parque San Martín to the Cerro San Bernardo summit. The newer Ala Delta lift, starting at the summit, is a separate attraction.

observations.baseStation: Av. San Martín y Hipólito Irigoyen, Parque San Martín, Salta
observations.hours: Daily 09:00–19:00 per Salta City Tourism; temporary closures possible.
observations.pricing: Paid; no current numeric amount verifiable on operator or municipal pages. Dynamic amount left unspecified.

scopeNotes: A 31 October 2026 municipal promotion advertised special 09:30–19:30 hours; regular City Tourism listing is 09:00–19:00. Calendar ends February 2027 and needs recheck.
Photographs date from 2009–2017 and are explicitly dated in their captions; the entrance image is historical and is not the cover.
Ala Delta is a distinct cable car at the summit and should be assessed as a separate standalone candidate.
